# 🏨 Hotel Booking Analytics & Cancellation Prediction

> End-to-end hotel booking intelligence system — EDA, SQL insights, interactive dashboard, and ML-based cancellation prediction (85% accuracy).

---

## 📌 Project Overview

A complete data analytics and machine learning project built on a real-world dataset of 119,390 hotel bookings across City and Resort hotels. The project covers the full pipeline — from raw data cleaning to a working cancellation prediction model — built over a 4-week internship.

**What this project answers:**
- What drives hotel booking demand and seasonality?
- Which customer segments and channels cancel the most?
- How do lead time, deposit type, and special requests affect cancellation behavior?
- Can we predict which bookings are likely to cancel before they do?

---

## 🚀 Live Dashboard

The project includes a fully interactive Streamlit dashboard with live filters, KPI cards, and 12 charts covering booking trends, cancellations, and revenue.

```bash
py -m streamlit run dashboards/app.py
```

Opens at `localhost:8501`. Use the sidebar to filter by hotel type and month — all charts and KPIs update automatically.

---

## 🤖 Machine Learning Model

A Random Forest classifier predicts whether a booking will be cancelled, trained on 95,512 bookings and tested on 23,878 unseen bookings.

| Metric | Logistic Regression | Random Forest |
|--------|---------------------|----------------|
| Accuracy | 80.71% | **85.18%** |
| Precision | 84.71% | 83.25% |
| Recall | 59.36% | **75.80%** |
| F1 Score | 69.80% | **79.35%** |
| ROC AUC | 76.46% | **83.31%** |

**Top predictors:** `lead_time` (25.9%), `adr` (22.3%), `deposit_type` (18.3% combined), `total_nights` (6.6%), `special_requests` (5.6%)

See [`reports/model_card.docx`](reports/model_card.docx) for full documentation including limitations and recommended use.

## ⚙️ Setup Instructions

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/karan-tyagi17/hotel-booking-analytics.git
cd hotel-booking-analytics

# 2. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. Download the dataset and place it in data/raw/hotel_bookings.csv
# (see Kaggle link above)

# 4. Run notebooks in order: 01 → 02 → 03 → 04

# 5. Launch the dashboard
py -m streamlit run dashboards/app.py
```

> Note: `data/raw/hotel_bookings.csv` and `src/cancellation_model.pkl` are excluded from version control (see `.gitignore`) — the dataset must be downloaded from Kaggle, and the model can be regenerated by running notebook `04`.

## 📈 Key Business Findings

1. **City Hotel cancels at nearly double the rate of Resort Hotel** (41.73% vs 27.76%), consistently across every month.
2. **Direct bookings are the most valuable channel** — lowest cancellation rate (15.34%) and highest true value per booking (€97.73).
3. **Lead time strongly predicts cancellations** — bookings made 180+ days in advance cancel 57% of the time vs only 9.63% for last-minute bookings.
4. **A guest who cancelled once will very likely cancel again** — 94.43% repeat cancellation rate.
5. **Special requests signal commitment** — guests with 5 requests cancel only 5% of the time vs 47.72% for guests with none.
6. **Portugal dominates bookings but is high risk** (56.64% cancellation); Germany and France are far more reliable.
7. Full list of 12 insights with recommendations in [`reports/business_insights.docx`](reports/business_insights.docx).
